postState.name: OMEGA-TEST: TPO Compression Breakout
postState.description: A narrow prior-session value area is a coiled auction. Two required gates - width in the bottom quartile, and a close accepted outside the area - block anything else before the agent is billed. UP above the prior value high, DOWN below the prior value low, NEITHER while coiled or when value is wide. Prior-session columns only, live all day. Weights, levels and trailing mirror the vendor's validated volatility-compression breakout playbook.
postState.tagline: A narrow prior value area is a coil; a close accepted outside it is the break
postState.marketReadText: THESIS, UNMEASURED ON THIS PLATFORM: a narrow prior-session value area is a coiled auction, and a 1h close accepted outside it tends to run at least the area's width. This book trades that acceptance in the break's direction; it never fades a break and never trades a wide area. No backtest exists; the width threshold was the bottom quartile of the universe on 2026-09-12 (it moved from 2.06% to 2.32% in two days) and is being re-measured hourly. GATES, required, the platform blocks otherwise: {NARROW_PRIOR_VALUE} TRUE = width {pTpoVAH_pTpoVAL_spread} at or under 2.3%. {BROKEN_OUT} TRUE = close at least 0.05% (one 5-bps bin) outside the area. DIRECTION is the verdict: {BREAK_ABOVE_NARROW_VALUE} TRUE, close {pTpoVAH_close_spread} beyond the prior high, LONG; {BREAK_BELOW_NARROW_VALUE} TRUE, close {pTpoVAL_close_spread} beyond the prior low, SHORT. {COILED_INSIDE_NARROW} TRUE is the setup forming, not the trade: wait. {WIDE_PRIOR_VALUE} TRUE: stand aside. CONFIGURED CONFIRMATION, the signals this book weights: volume_surge at RVOL ({RVOL}) 1.5 or more; volatility_atr_expanding, ATR ({ATR}, {atrPct}% of price) rising; bollinger_squeeze on Bollinger width ({bbWidthPct}), the heaviest weight; a Donchian break ({donchianHi} / {donchianLo}) the same way; trend_adx_ranging at ADX ({ADX}) under 20. A break without these is unconfirmed, not forbidden: the gate is TPO, the score is theirs. INVALIDATION by this book's own logic: a 1h close back inside prior value flips {COILED_INSIDE_NARROW} TRUE; exit. The prior POC, {pTpoPOC_close_spread} from the close, is the first reference inside the area. TARGET: at least 2R by configuration; the one-width measured move is the thesis, not a rule. CONFIGURED MANAGEMENT: 1h-close entry; stop 0.75-1.75 ATR; break-even 1R; trail from 1.2R, 35% giveback, 0.3% buffer; no time decay. Size within the presets; do not add to a failing break.

before.marketReadText: HOW THIS BOOK WORKS. A narrow prior-session value area means yesterday's auction agreed on price in a tight range: a coiled market. When a 1h close is accepted outside that area the auction has left it, and the move that follows tends to run at least the width of the area. This book trades that acceptance in the direction of the break. It never fades a break and never trades a wide value area. GATES, required, the platform blocks otherwise: {NARROW_PRIOR_VALUE} TRUE = prior value width {pTpoVAH_pTpoVAL_spread} at or under 2.3%, the bottom quartile of the universe. {BROKEN_OUT} TRUE = the close is at least 0.05% (one 5-bps bin) outside the area. DIRECTION is the verdict. {BREAK_ABOVE_NARROW_VALUE} TRUE, close {pTpoVAH_close_spread} beyond the prior high: LONG. {BREAK_BELOW_NARROW_VALUE} TRUE, close {pTpoVAL_close_spread} beyond the prior low: SHORT. {COILED_INSIDE_NARROW} TRUE is the setup forming, not the trade: wait for the close outside. {WIDE_PRIOR_VALUE} TRUE: stand aside. WHAT A GOOD BREAK LOOKS LIKE: volume, RVOL ({RVOL}) at 1.5 or more, a break on dry volume is a probe; expanding range, ATR ({ATR}, {atrPct}% of price) rising; Bollinger width ({bbWidthPct}) coming off a squeeze, which is the bollinger_squeeze signal this book weights most; a Donchian break ({donchianHi} / {donchianLo}) the same way; ADX ({ADX}) under 20 going in, because breaks out of a range are the ones with room. INVALIDATION: a 1h close back inside prior value is a failed break, exit. The prior POC, {pTpoPOC_close_spread} from the close, is where failed breaks fall back to first. TARGET: the measured move is one value-area width from the broken edge; the book demands at least 2R. MANAGEMENT: entry on the 1h close; stop 0.75-1.75 ATR; break-even at 1R; trail from 1.2R giving back 35% with a 0.3% buffer; no time decay, a break is allowed to take time. Size within the presets; do not add to a break that is failing.

section.title: TPO compression breakout
section.text:
Positive spread means the first metric sits above the second. pTpoVAH: the upper edge of the previous completed UTC session's 70% value area. pTpoVAH_pTpoVAL_spread: % gap pTpoVAH vs pTpoVAL. pTpoVAL: the lower edge of the previous completed UTC session's 70% value area. pTpoVAL_close_spread: % gap pTpoVAL vs close. pTpoVAH_close_spread: % gap pTpoVAH vs close. pTpoPOC: the price bin that held the most time in the previous completed UTC session. pTpoPOC_close_spread: % gap pTpoPOC vs close. atrPct: average true range as a % of price, (ATR / close) × 100 — the cross-coin comparable form of ATR. bbWidthPct: Bollinger band spread as a % of its own middle band, ((upper − lower) / middle) × 100 — the cross-coin comparable form of BBwidth. RVOL: relative volume — the bar’s volume divided by its 20-period average, as a multiple (1.0 = at baseline, 2.0 = twice baseline). BBtouch: price contact with a Bollinger band (upper / lower / none). BBwidth: the Bollinger band spread, upper − lower, in price units — read against that coin’s own history; the cross-coin comparable form is bbWidthPct. donchianHi: the highest high of the last 20 closed bars — the Donchian channel's upper edge. donchianLo: the lowest low of the last 20 closed bars — the Donchian channel's lower edge. ADX: 14-period average directional index (trend strength, 0–100). ATR: 14-period average true range, in price units.

marketReadPreview.gridText: THESIS, UNMEASURED ON THIS PLATFORM: a narrow prior-session value area is a coiled auction, and a 1h close accepted outside it tends to run at least the area's width. This book trades that acceptance in the break's direction; it never fades a break and never trades a wide area. No backtest exists; the width threshold was the bottom quartile of the universe on 2026-09-12 (it moved from 2.06% to 2.32% in two days) and is being re-measured hourly. GATES, required, the platform blocks otherwise: NARROW_PRIOR_VALUE TRUE = width pTpoVAH_pTpoVAL_spread at or under 2.3%. BROKEN_OUT TRUE = close at least 0.05% (one 5-bps bin) outside the area. DIRECTION is the verdict: BREAK_ABOVE_NARROW_VALUE TRUE, close pTpoVAH_close_spread beyond the prior high, LONG; BREAK_BELOW_NARROW_VALUE TRUE, close pTpoVAL_close_spread beyond the prior low, SHORT. COILED_INSIDE_NARROW TRUE is the setup forming, not the trade: wait. WIDE_PRIOR_VALUE TRUE: stand aside. CONFIGURED CONFIRMATION, the signals this book weights: volume_surge at RVOL (RVOL) 1.5 or more; volatility_atr_expanding, ATR (ATR, atrPct% of price) rising; bollinger_squeeze on Bollinger width (bbWidthPct), the heaviest weight; a Donchian break (donchianHi / donchianLo) the same way; trend_adx_ranging at ADX (ADX) under 20. A break without these is unconfirmed, not forbidden: the gate is TPO, the score is theirs. INVALIDATION by this book's own logic: a 1h close back inside prior value flips COILED_INSIDE_NARROW TRUE; exit. The prior POC, pTpoPOC_close_spread from the close, is the first reference inside the area. TARGET: at least 2R by configuration; the one-width measured move is the thesis, not a rule. CONFIGURED MANAGEMENT: 1h-close entry; stop 0.75-1.75 ATR; break-even 1R; trail from 1.2R, 35% giveback, 0.3% buffer; no time decay. Size within the presets; do not add to a failing break.

Conditions are deterministic reads of your report columns, resolved server-side at prompt-build time. They are advisory: they may make you more selective, never less — they do not gate, score, or qualify anything. TRUE / FALSE / UNRESOLVED are three distinct states; UNRESOLVED means an input was missing, not that the read was false.
